remarks:
Own a piece of the action just steps from NIAGARA FALLS STATE PARK-one of the most iconic destinations in the world! This beautifully updated home isn't just a retreat it's a profitable, turnkey AirBnB that lets you vacation and earn at the same time. Discover this rare investment opportunity just moments from NIAGARA FALLS STATE PARK-one of the worlds most visited natural wonders! This fully furnished, turnkey short-term rental (approved zone) is already generating exceptional income ( 2023: 23,944.41 & 2024: $27,163.83, 2025: $28,377.53 in sales from AirBnB & VRBO) & comes with everything you need to keep it running profitably from day one. Prime location walks to the Falls State Park, entertainment district, & attractions. Beautifully updated interiors with
modern finishes & decor. Strong rental history & consistent 5-Star guest reviews. Fully furnished, stocked, & licensed for short-term rental use. Low maintenance exterior. Whether you're looking to expand your AirBnB portfolio or start your first short-term rental business, this home offers a proven return & unbeatable location for the money. Own a piece of the Niagara Falls experience-where adventure & income meet!! Out of State buyers looking to own an income-producing property in one of New York's top tourist destinations-without the hassle of managing it yourself? This licensed, turnkey AirBnB comes with management opportunity to make this investment completely hands-free. Proven track record of high occupancy and excellent reviews. With millions of visitors Niagara Falls offers consistent demand & strong returns. Whether you're looking to diversify your portfolio or add reliable, remotely managed property, this investment checks every box. Turn the world's most famous waterfall into your next cash-flowing asset. Property offers 3 bedrooms & one bath & can legally sleep six (6) people as a AirBnB. Features a detached 1.5 car garage with a dog run for those guests traveling with their beloved pets. Finished attic ideal for a game room. Property is within walking distance to Niagara Falls State Park, Casino, Entertainment district & Canada. Plenty of off Street parking. Walking distance to the Falls
